I checked each claim in the draft against the policy.

- "Good tea, no fuss." This is plain, warm and unhurried. It makes no superlative and uses no banned words. Fine.
- "Certified organic by the Soil Association" matches the allowlist wording exactly (certificate renewed 2026).
- "packed by hand in Bristol" is a close paraphrase of "Every tin is packed by hand in Bristol" (Operations). The meaning is the same and it doesn't overstate anything. Fine.
- "free UK delivery on orders over £25" matches the shipping policy wording exactly.
- Spelling is UK, with no health, green, urgency or guarantee claims, and no invented numbers.
- No disclosure is needed. This is our own landing page, not a creator post or an affiliate link.

Nothing needs changing. As with all public content, it still needs Sam's approval before it goes live.
